subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: The risk policy — floor classes, AUTO classes, activation state, thresholds — shall be versioned, closed-schema data with a validator and an operator kill switch, and unknown keys shall be defects.
rationale: policy as human-ratified data (AP-6, AP-8, AP-24); one-change kill
fit_criterion: a malformed or unknown-key policy refuses to load and the lane treats everything HUMAN; the kill switch flips the lane to HUMAN-only in one data change (drill)
